## About MindWake™

MindWake™ is formulated for healthy adults seeking convenient daily nutritional support for cognitive wellness. Its carefully selected combination of botanical extracts, nutrients, amino acids, and Alpha GPC is designed to complement a balanced diet and healthy lifestyle.

MindWake™ supports:

 Memory and recall
 Mental clarity
 Focus and concentration
 Learning and mental processing
 Everyday cognitive function
 Daily cognitive wellness

## Ingredients

### Ginkgo Biloba Leaf Extract

Supports healthy circulation and cognitive performance as part of a daily wellness routine.

### Phosphatidylserine

A naturally occurring phospholipid that provides nutritional support for memory, learning, and mental processing.

### N-Acetyl L-Carnitine HCI

An amino acid derivative involved in cellular energy metabolism that supports focus, mental clarity, and cognitive wellness.

### Bacopa Monnieri Leaf Extract

A botanical ingredient traditionally used to support memory retention, learning, and cognitive function.

### L-Glutamine

An amino acid involved in normal neurotransmitter and cellular processes that provides nutritional support for healthy brain communication.

### Alpha GPC

A choline-containing compound that supports acetylcholine, an important neurotransmitter involved in memory and learning.

## Daily Cognitive Support

MindWake™ is designed to fit easily into a consistent daily wellness routine. The formula provides nutritional support for adults who want to maintain mental sharpness, memory, focus, learning, and cognitive wellness.

Use MindWake™ only according to the directions provided on the product label.

## Safety & Disclaimer

Individual experiences may vary. Always use MindWake™ according to the product label. If you are pregnant, nursing, taking medication, or have a medical condition, consult a qualified healthcare professional before use.

MindWake™ is a dietary supplement intended to complement a balanced diet and healthy lifestyle. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.

These statements have not been evaluated by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA). This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
